headline: Reporting For Duty
caption:
🇦🇺 Quillan Salkilld wants in on UFC Sydney after six straight wins 🔥
Title run or step up? 👇

The Australian lightweight posted "Reporting for duty" as the UFC heads back to Sydney on Feb. 7 at Afterpay Arena. His last two wins were finishes of Beneil Dariush and Mateusz Gamrot. UFC news.

Who should he face?
question: Title run or step up?

v2.story: After finishing Dariush and Gamrot, Salkilld is eyeing a home fight in Sydney on Feb. 7.
v2.question: Title run or step up?
